about: Benchmark corpora (decisions M-6 and M-12). Only the synthetic corpus ships with the repository; the others are read where they are installed and never copied. Workshop items are pinned by their Workshop manifest and a content hash, and a run on another version is reported as a corpus change.

corpora.name: Project fixtures
corpora.note: The CI smoke workspace (fixtures/*/workspace merged into one mod with a stand-in game) plus the hand-written regression mod in bench/fixtures/synthetic.
